svg.title: Development notice
svg.desc: As of firmware 3.10.1, development on Plugin Manager USB for Open-MPC will be halted. Akai now supports external plugin development, and plugins can be installed directly in the appropriate location. The official Open-MPC plugin already handles this, making Plugin Manager USB obsolete. Thank you for trying it out and for your support.
